Specification: This module defines the built-in TLAPS support module containing backend prover pragmas and a library of theorem statements used in mechanical proofs. It models no concrete algorithm or transition system; instead, it provides boolean operators whose only purpose is to carry prover annotations, together with temporal-logic proof rules such as invariance, simulation, weak fairness, strong fairness, and leads-to rules. The file also includes compatibility aliases for older prover pragmas, a set extensionality theorem, a theorem asserting that no set contains every element, and several temporal proof principles, some with omitted proofs.
AssumeProveBlocks:
ASSUME STATE P, STATE f,
                           P /\ (f' = f) => P'
                    PROVE  []P <=> P /\ [][P => P']_f

ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, STATE g,
                           ACTION A, ACTION B,
                           P /\ [A]_f => Q /\ [B]_g
                    PROVE  []P /\ [][A]_f => []Q /\ [][B]_g

ASSUME STATE I, STATE F,  ACTION N,
                           I /\ [N]_F => I'
                    PROVE  I /\ [][N]_F => []I

ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, ACTION N
                    PROVE  []I => ([][N]_f <=> [][N /\ I /\ I']_f)

ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f, ACTION N, ACTION A,
                          P /\ [N]_f => (P' \/ Q'),
                          P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q',
                          P => ENABLED <<A>>_f
                   PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) => (P ~> Q)

ASSUME STATE P, STATE Q, STATE f,
                          ACTION N, ACTION A, TEMPORAL F,
                          P /\ [N]_f => (P' \/ Q'),
                          P /\ <<N /\ A>>_f => Q',
                          []P /\ [][N]_f /\ []F => <> ENABLED <<A>>_f
                   PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => (P ~> Q)

ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM,
                          ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M,
                          TEMPORAL F,
                          <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g,
                          P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B,
                          P /\ EM => ENABLED A,
                          [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F /\ <>[]EM => <>[]P
                   PROVE  [][N]_f /\ WF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g \/ []<>(~EM)

ASSUME STATE P, STATE f, STATE g, STATE EM,
                          ACTION A, ACTION B, ACTION N, ACTION M,
                          TEMPORAL F,
                          <<N /\ B>>_f => <<M>>_g,
                          P /\ P' /\ <<N /\ A>>_f /\ EM => B,
                          P /\ EM => ENABLED A,
                          [][N /\ ~B]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F /\ []<>EM => <>[]P
                   PROVE  [][N]_f /\ SF_f(A) /\ []F => []<><<M>>_g \/ <>[](~EM)

ASSUME STATE F, STATE G,
         F => G
  PROVE  []F => []G

ASSUME STATE I, STATE f, STATE g,
         ACTION M, ACTION N,
         I /\ I' /\ [M]_f => [N]_g
  PROVE  []I /\ [][M]_f => [][N]_g
